_note: Kysaro's camera tuning for the themed character-creation screens (#704). x_offset moves the camera sideways and distance_offset away from the character, in scene metres (each within -3 to 3; a more negative x_offset moves the character right on screen). fov_offset widens the vertical field of view in radians (within -0.5 to 1); widening it too far bulges the picture, so zoom out with distance_offset first. Read once per launch: restart the game after editing. A value out of range or not a number reverts to 0 with a warning in the TAOM log.
